passage: The employee self-service portal is now available to all staff. Users can update contact information and review benefit requests. [blank] A step-by-step guide is attached. If you have trouble signing in, contact the help desk at extension 440.
prompt: Which sentence best fits the blank?
choices: The portal replaces the paper directory in the lobby.
It explains how to use each feature of the portal.
The help desk will move next month.
Benefit requests are reviewed only once a year.
explanation: An attached step-by-step guide explains the portal features.
